normal_runner_minimum_design.scalar_wiring: Use frozen 38-test RuntimeScalarConnection at original execute_model/_prepare_inputs/sample_tokens. normal_runner_minimum_design.event_scope: Two observation-only timing events on the original compute stream, across full execute-to-sample boundary; resolve only query-ready pairs. No observation-induced synchronization/wait or same-stage substitution. Native full-step timer is unimplemented here.

New eligible opt-in worker constructor wiring can provide original journal without changing acceptance/completion/queues. Native injection not installed by this batch.
normal_runner_minimum_design.full_step_attribution: Read original published scalar copies at tail; four stage existing inflight at mapped start and all actually accepted added operations inside exact mapped step. Do not call old journal.attribute and relabel model_forward as full_decode_step.

Consume actual post-shutdown inspect_snapshot/native fields only after success; never infer from Future.done or clear owner lists in observer.
normal_runner_minimum_design.outputs: Independent original frontend complete 128 token list must match every actual scalar sample frame; no trace truncation, keep real cold prefill context0. Pure decode selection/warmup context>=1 remains separate.

implemented_CPU_interfaces.before_execute: off returns before ordinal/factory reads; enabled records begin for contiguous native ordinal.
implemented_CPU_interfaces.after_sample: requires exact frozen closed scalar frame for that ordinal; execute None alone cannot end; records end only here.
implemented_CPU_interfaces.resolve_ready: start/end.query; read finite positive elapsed only when ready; never synchronize/wait; not-ready stays bounded pending. origin strictly cpu_fixture, event_elapsed_ns is fake event contract scalar; gpu_elapsed_ns always None.
implemented_CPU_interfaces.CPUClockReference: Fixture-only mapping explicitly separate from real cross-clock qualification. No mapped wall endpoints or IO when unknown/fallback. This does not implement a native anchor calibration.
implemented_CPU_interfaces.attribute_published_full_step: Only bounded immutable original published tuple; sequential acceptance/completion identities, monotonic owner clocks, same run/native SHA, valid owner coverage, no ambiguous boundary ties or failed/short/missing actual added completion. Returns CPU_ATTRIBUTION_CONTRACT_ONLY for all four stages. No release/bandwidth/cost qualification.
implemented_CPU_interfaces.run_g2_normal_model_candidate: --preflight CPU reads exactly six fixed source byte/SHA refs, imports none of their source, creates no cache/output, reports all qualification false. --run returns exit2 before source/GPU import because normal-model wiring is intentionally unimplemented/unqualified.
implemented_CPU_interfaces.drain_contract: Reuse frozen DrainEvidence requiring actual transferred bytes, failed ops and empty original owner fields. CPU short-result test rejects even when accepted==completed_requested. Native snapshot conversion/provider remains unimplemented.
